# Model Evaluation Lab

A Muse agent skill for reproducible model evaluations: freeze an evaluation plan (decision, baseline, candidates, cases, metrics, budget, stopping rules), execute or normalize benchmark runs, and write a model-selection memo that separates measurement from judgment. Use when comparing models, prompts, agents, or deployment configurations. It never invents scores or winners — "no decision" is a valid, honest result.
